---
title: "Editorial marks [++ in the title]"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # GH #1102: every mark becomes a call to the template's annotation functions instead
      # of plain body text, and the document compiles (the functions are defined).
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '#quarto-insert\(\)\[Inserted text\.\];'
          - '#quarto-delete\(\)\[Deleted text\.\];'
          - '#quarto-highlight\(\)\[highlighted\];'
          - '#quarto-edit-comment\(author: "Ana", date: "2026-11-07"\)\[Is this right\?\];'
          # the `;` ends the call, so a following `(` stays text
          - '#quarto-insert\(\)\[x\];\\\(after\)'
          - '#quarto-delete-block\(\)\['
          - '#quarto-edit-comment-block\(author: "Ana"\)\['
          - '#let quarto-insert\(author: none, date: none, body\)'
          - 'title: \[Editorial marks #quarto-insert\(\)\[in the title\];\]'
        -
          # the unfixed output: the marks' text as plain prose
          - 'Inserted text\. Deleted text\.'
---

[++ Inserted text.] [-- Deleted text.] Some [!! highlighted] words.
[>> Is this right?]{author="Ana" date="2026-11-07"}

Edge case: [++ x](after).

::: --

A deleted paragraph.

:::

::: >> {author="Ana"}

A block comment.

:::
